page_title: PSG 4-2 STR | PSG v Strasbourg 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Milan Skriniar (PSG) for a tough tackle.

90+6' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90+3' 4 - 2 Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg) collects the ball deep inside the box from a rebound after the corner kick. He beats the keeper with a sharp shot! It's a goal!
90+3' It will be a corner kick for Strasbourg.
90+1' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' 4 - 1 Goal! Joao Neves feeds Kang-In Lee (PSG), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 4:1.

89' Desire Doue (PSG) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
87' Substitution. Daouda Diongue (Strasbourg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sebastian Nanasi walks off.
86' Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) has a sight of goal and shoots goalwards, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
85' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Strasbourg seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG) comes onto the pitch so that Bradley Barcola can be given a rest.
80' Here is a change. Dilane Bakwa is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
75' PSG earn a corner.
75' It will be a substitution. Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) is ready to enter the pitch as Junior Mwanga walks off.
72' Today's referee Jeremy Stinat rightly decides to book Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) for his harsh tackle.
69' The goal by PSG won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
68' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The PSG players aren’t happy.
68' Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) scores an own goal! No one would like to be in his position right now.
67' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Senny Mayulu will be replaced by Fabian Ruiz (PSG).
66' 3 - 1 Willian Pacho plays a neat ball into the path of Bradley Barcola (PSG), who makes room for a shot and sends in a low drive which bounces in off the right post! 3:1.
66' Referee Jeremy Stinat signals NO PENALTY for PSG after a VAR review!
64' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to PSG using VAR. Let's see what happens.
64' Bradley Barcola (PSG) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
62' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jeremy Stinat signals.
60' Lucas Beraldo (PSG) has received a yellow card for his foul.
58' The game has come to an end for Marco Asensio. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Kang-In Lee (PSG).
58' 2 - 1 Goal! Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.

57' Bradley Barcola (PSG) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Djordje Petrovic to get hold of the ball.
53' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

52' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him! The ball goes out for a corner. Strasbourg can continue in their attacking effort.
51' PSG quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

50' Senny Mayulu (PSG) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Djordje Petrovic. The ball is out of play and PSG manage to earn a corner.
50' Abakar Sylla (Strasbourg) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' 2 - 0 Goal! A rebound wrong foots everyone except Marco Asensio (PSG), and he slams the ball into the open net from close range. 2:0.
46' Half-time substitution. Marvin Senaya will not participate anymore and Saidou Sow (Strasbourg) is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Liam Rosenior gives a chance to Sekou Mara and Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is off.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Wonderful movement by PSG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

42' Senny Mayulu (PSG) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.

41' Bradley Barcola (PSG) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
40' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
38' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
35' Desire Doue (PSG) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
33' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
31' The game is interrupted now, Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' PSG showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
25' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
24' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
21' Marco Asensio (PSG) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Djordje Petrovic.
21' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
20' Senny Mayulu (PSG) whips in a cross from the corner, but Djordje Petrovic is well positioned and punches the ball away. PSG have been awarded a corner kick.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Bradley Barcola plays a pass to the feet of Senny Mayulu (PSG), and he shoots inside the left post from inside the box. It's 1:0.
17' Senny Mayulu (PSG) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.

15' PSG slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
14' The ball is cleared after Bradley Barcola (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
12' What a great touch by Senny Mayulu (PSG)! He picks up a precise pass and produces a long-range shot, but his fabulous effort smashes off the right post!
10' Jeremy Stinat shows the yellow card to Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) for a heavy challenge.
10' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Gianluigi Donnarumma is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
8' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

7' Strasbourg are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The referee points to the corner flag and Strasbourg will take a corner.
7' Bradley Barcola (PSG) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
7' Desire Doue (PSG) wriggles into space inside the box with excellent ball control, but his effort on goal is well blocked. The referee blows his whistle, PSG are awarded a corner kick.
4' Strasbourg fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
2' Bradley Barcola (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
2' It looks like Senny Mayulu (PSG) saw red with that tackle. Jeremy Stinat won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
PSG will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jeremy Stinat.
